model.name: TTS Fish Audio Drama 3
model.description: Built with Fish Audio. Expressive speech and dialogue with up to three voice references, automatic reference transcription, and long-script context. FP8 experts execute on the CPU and use about 32 GB of system memory; 48 GB or more is recommended. Choose INT4 Experts when RAM is limited.
model.selector_help: FP8 experts alone use about 32 GB of system memory; 48 GB or more is recommended. Choose INT4 Experts when RAM is limited. Legacy uses CPU experts; vLLM acceleration appears when its required kernels are installed. GPU expert caching and graph replay depend on available VRAM and verified placement.

prompt:
Speaker 1: [confident, almost playful] Look, it’s simple. You just have to stop trusting the cameras.
Speaker 2: [skeptical, raising an eyebrow] Cameras? I’ve seen satellites, Mark.
Speaker 1: [waving a hand dismissively, then leaning in] Manufactured images. Have you ever felt the curve?
Speaker 2: [frustrated, sighing] I’ve flown in planes. I’ve crossed oceans.
Speaker 1: [insistent, then dropping to a whisper] That’s exactly what they want you to think. The horizon is perfectly straight, isn’t it?
Speaker 2: [exhausted, rubbing her temples] It looks straight because we’re on top of a sphere, not because it’s flat.
Speaker 1: [smiling mysteriously, slowly] And who told you that... The same people selling you the round rock.
